en: *sigh*

Are you okay, Tsumugi?
You look down...

It's because there's no internet...or TV...
or manga here...

Cut off from all my sources of moe energy,
I'm starting to waste away...

There are some anime in the A/V Room, but...
I need fresh moe energy... *sigh*
<CLT=cltMIND>Sh-She's actually depressed!

H-Hey, Tsumugi.
Do you have any other hobbies?

I saw a lot of stuff in the warehouse, so maybe
you can find some other things to do in there.
Other things...?
Like what? I can't think of anything.
What? Like...nothing?

I just realized! Without cosplay and my otaku
hobbies...I've got nothing left!

<CLT=cltMIND>Wait, hold on... I'm worried about Tsumugi,
but now that I think about it...
Without the piano, I'd have nothing left either!
Tsumugi! L-Let's find another hobby!

Yeah, I agree! We both need to have 
interests outside of our talents!
How about baking?
How about reading?
How about going out to cafes?
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltMIND>Hm...another hobby...
How about baking?

I dunno... That seems like something that 
needs more girl power than I've got...

You can start casually and improve. It might
even be a little fun making mistakes.

Hmm, you're right. If it's just us, indoors,
then there's less pressure...
I might be able to make some sweets.
How about reading?
Reading, huh?

I normally read light novels, so that doesn't
really seem like a new hobby.
Wait!? Could it be!?

Are you the type that doesn't consider light
novels real books!? If so, then that means war!

No, I don't think that. But maybe you should
try reading a different kind of book.

Oh, how about a cookbook?
That's pretty standard.

Cooking... Yeah, that might be good.
It'll be useful in the future.
How about going out to cafes?

Going to cafes!? Isn't that too high of 
a hurdle to jump!?

Huh? Is it too expensive for you? I thought
it'd be good since we could walk there, too.

I'm usually indoors all the time, 
so being outdoors is just plain difficult...

Then, even more reason to go! You gotta
try something new!

Umm...you're right. I won't be alone, 
so it might be a good opportunity!

After we get out of here, let's do it
together, Tsumugi.
Y-Yeah...

Huh, what's the matter? You don't sound
too excited.

No, that's not it. I was just thinking 
it's strange...
You're a pianist and I'm a cosplayer, right?

We're from completely different worlds, and
yet...we're talking about sharing a hobby.

But that's not a bad thing. This'll be 
the start of a new story.
<CLT=cltMIND>She's right...

<CLT=cltMIND>Of course, I'm not happy with realizing I'd
be nothing without the piano...

<CLT=cltMIND>But now I know there will be new stories I
can experience from this encounter!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Tsumugi's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with her.

<CLT=cltMIND>After parting ways with Tsumugi, I returned
to my room.
